description: (needs account token) Turns lead collection on or off for a claimed site. Visitors can send a name, email and message. Each message is emailed to the owner's mailbox and kept for the dashboard. Claim the site first. Does not charge.

enabled.description: True turns the contact form on. False turns it off.

site.description: The address of a claimed site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
